labelNotes: No Recommended Operating Conditions table and no supply-voltage row in the Electrical Characteristics on these pages (VIN appears only as test conditions and as the (VIN - VOUT) differential), so supply_voltage_V is ABSENT. Quiescent Current 5 TYP / 11 MAX mA (columns confirmed with pdftotext); its '(VIN - VOUT) = 1.5V' condition is not an allowed key. Adjust Pin Current (55/120 uA) and its change (0.2/5 uA) are analog ADJ-pin bias currents and Minimum Load Current is an output current; all excluded. Abs max 'Input Voltage 15V' is a single-rating cell, labelled ABS_MAX.
